limits: Private prototype only: no public prototype installer, complete menu/room coverage, retail backend or campaign/fidelity acceptance.
Only five generic libraries reused; all selected prototype BOOT/modules/VU compile fresh. Generated sources/qualified metadata are still private inputs, not a fresh ISO-only recipe.

The original Room Jump bootstrap uses explicitly recorded diagnostic controller requests after failed window activation. It is not actual-key or cold-start keyboard acceptance. No fake pad or game memory/ready/flag writes.

Actual F1 opens/closes; F2 is refused while F1 owns input, then accepted afterward. One short Down tap does not move the cursor; cause unknown. The later K attempt meets the watchdog-ended window and is not close proof.

Unmatched action evidence, not image parity. PNGs are unchanged; capture size changes640x480 to640x515 during foreground/window interaction, cause not isolated. No crop/resize/normalization or widescreen fix.

F1 does not establish an acknowledged pause. Held/repeat/focus-loss semantics, physical peripherals/audio, real Save/Load and broader campaign/strict VU1 fidelity remain open. GUI backend JPEG originals stay private under the current PNG-only comparison protocol.
